# Public Repository Boundary

This repository is intentionally a public record of learning.

## Safe to publish

- Study notes
- General explanations
- Standard algorithms
- Original small implementations
- Educational experiments
- Public datasets and references
- Paper summaries
- Publicly reproducible mini-projects
- Lessons learned from debugging

## Keep private elsewhere

- Credentials and secrets
- Private source code
- Personal data
- Internal infrastructure details
- Private deployment configuration
- Unreleased research details
- Details that identify or reconstruct a private system

When uncertain, keep the material private.
